article: Films about mathematics, codebreaking, and physics
scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; checked all six film descriptions against official distributor, film-database, or film-site descriptions; checked film count, genre, real-person/dramatization framing, metadata dates, image targets, official links, and localized Ramanujan internal links.
findings: Replaced the inaccurate three-film introduction with a six-title scope and separated fictional/dramatized films from the Particle Fever documentary.
Corrected descriptions of Enigma (2001), The Imitation Game, The Man Who Knew Infinity, The Theory of Everything, and Particle Fever; added a note that historical dramas may fictionalize events.
Fixed duplicate and conflicting publication dates, preserving the original 2022-09-05 publication date and adding lastmod 2026-11-24.
Removed references to two nonexistent image files while retaining available images; repaired the locale-specific Ramanujan links and added official film information sources.
